CONDITIONAL WHAT-IFS

Scenario lab

ⓘ Flagged intervals exceed both March demand P95 and the selected March lux percentile. Reductions apply only where data checks pass; the percentage is a what-if assumption, not a validated dimming setting.
How to read the investigation rule

P95 is the level at or below which 95% of valid March readings fall for that zone. P90 is less restrictive; P97.5 is stricter. Demand always uses March P95. Cutoffs are frozen before evaluating April and do not define comfortable lighting. The coverage setting checks March calibration and April demand/lux availability. Cleaned intervals can contain interpolation.
